name: Temporary Visitor Visa (9(a)) / visa-free entry

requirements.blocker_text: Many nationalities enter visa-free for 30 days under Executive Order 408, extendable at Bureau of Immigration offices up to a cumulative maximum of 36 months without leaving the country; other nationalities need a consular 9(a) Temporary Visitor Visa.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a 9(a) visa at a Philippine embassy or consulate if not visa-exempt.

requirements.blocker_text: Covers tourism, business meetings, medical treatment, and event attendance; does not authorise employment.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the relevant work or long-stay route instead if employment is intended.

outcome.duration_length: 30 days initially, extendable at Bureau of Immigration offices up to a cumulative 36 months total before a mandatory exit
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: cumulative 36-month cap on continuous extension without leaving the Philippines

sources.title: Philippine Hub Partners -- Philippine Visa Requirements 2026: Investor Visas, describing the 9(a) visa-waiver/extension structure under EO 408 and the 36-month cumulative extension ceiling
